subject: Fwd: Lumera Therapeutics — hosted API pricing request
messages:
From: Jennifer Miller <jennifer@lumeratx.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Lumera — hosted API pricing request

Hi Grace / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — everything looks promising on our end. Execs asked me to push for a better hosted API unit price before we finalize the SOW. Our preliminary forecast (attached) shows ~3.2B tokens over the first 12 months across multi-region endpoints.

Given that volume and the strategic nature of this integration for us, Lumera is asking if Redwood can provide a 28% reduction off list hosted API usage rates (hosted text gen + embeddings combo), extended to all three regions we deploy in.

I realize this is beyond standard discount bands, but the deal economics are compelling: multi-year pilot -> enterprise wide if performance holds. We can commit to a 12-month minimum spend and provide a short-term reference case.

Can you let me know whether Redwood leadership can approve this kind of concession, and what conditions you would need (commit term, invoice cadence, data residency) to move forward?

Attachments: Lumera_usage_profile.xlsx, Lumera_SOW_v2.pdf

Appreciate the quick turnaround — our board wants a vendor recommendation by Friday.

Best,
Jennifer Miller
Director, Cloud Integrations
Lumera Therapeutics
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-20T10:05:00-05:00
Subject: Fwd: Lumera — hosted API pricing request

Team — forwarding Lumera's ask. They want ~28% off hosted API list across regions for ~3.2B tokens / 12 months. HubSpot shows this as a fast-moving strategic pilot with clear expansion potential (deal id DEAL-8421).

Context:
- They are ready to sign an SOW if pricing is acceptable.
- Will take 3-region deploy (us-east, eu-west, ap-southeast) — they care about regional parity.
- They requested board-level recommendation by Friday (5 days).

Ask: need senior signoff for >20% concession. Marcus — can finance approve 28% with the following conditions?
1) 12-month committed spend (min $450k/mo equivalent)
2) Prepay first quarter invoicing or net-15 with corporate PO
3) Standard data residency addendum for EU tokens (we can do customer-managed VPC where needed)

I've attached their usage profile and SOW for reference. If we can't get 28%, what's the maximum we can give executive-approved today and on what terms?

Thanks — Grace
Grace O'Connor
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-20T11:18:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Lumera — hosted API pricing request

Quick add: Lumera's HS (healthcare) use case has strong reference value. They are evaluating us vs two managed providers and one cloud-managed endpoint. Competitive intel: both competitors are offering ~20% list, but neither supports cross-region parity without significant setup. Lumera also asked about longer-term reserved capacity (Dedicated) down the road — so hosted API concession is a gateway.

I recommend we aim for up to 25% approved here, but only if finance requires a 12-month minimum commit and invoice prepay for Q1. If Marcus can sign off on 25% today we can keep commercial ownership and avoid involving legal for a large precedent.

Ben
Account Executive — Strategic Deals
From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-20T13:37:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Lumera — hosted API pricing request

Thanks for the context. I've reviewed the usage profile and ARR math. Finance can approve an exception up to 25% off list for Hosted API usage under the following mandatory conditions:

1) 12-month committed spend equal to a minimum annualized $5.4M (equivalent to the forecasted 3.2B tokens at proposed usage rates).
2) Payment terms: prepay for first two months at signature + net-30 thereafter with a signed PO referencing DEAL-8421.
3) Enablement: Customer must accept standard production observability add-on (Redwood Console 90-day retention) to discourage cost anomalies. Add-on will be included at no charge for the first 90 days.
4) Legal: Standard SOW and GDPR data residency addendum; no precedent-setting CLAs in the SOW.

If these conditions are acceptable, we'll sign off at 25% and finance will confirm pricing for Ben to send the commercial SOW. Anything beyond 25% requires VP-level approval (Marcus or VP-Finance escalation and likely a cross-functional review).

I'll mark this as approved conditionally. Please prepare an updated SOW reflecting the commit and payment mechanics, and circulate to legal.

Marcus Lin
Head of Finance — Redwood Inference
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
To: Jennifer Miller <jennifer@lumeratx.com>, Pete Alvarez <pete@lumeratx.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-20T15:37:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Lumera — hosted API pricing request

Hi Jennifer / Pete — thanks for the clear forecast and for moving quickly.

Good news: our finance team can approve a 25% concession off hosted API list rates for Lumera's first year, subject to a few conditions that Marcus included below:

- 12-month committed spend (minimum annualized $5.4M)
- Prepayment for months 1-2 at signature, then net-30 with signed PO referencing DEAL-8421
- Redwood Console production observability add-on enabled (90-day retention included at no charge for the initial period)
- Standard SOW + GDPR/data residency addendum for EU region traffic

If those terms are acceptable, Ben will update the SOW and circulate for signature / DocuSign. I know you asked about a 28% price; to be transparent, 25% is the max finance will approve without VP-level escalation. If Lumera needs more, we can pursue an escalation path but that will take 48–72 hours and require executive review.

Next steps:
1) Confirm in writing that Lumera accepts the conditions above.
2) Ben will issue a redlined SOW with the 25% rate and the commit numbers.
3) We'll route the SOW/DocuSign link and request prepayment details.

Appreciate the urgency — we'll prioritize the SOW for turnaround today if you confirm.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

--
Attachment summary: Lumera_SOW_v2.pdf (SOW draft), Lumera_usage_profile.xlsx (monthly token forecast)
